summary: Iteration 19 - Comprehensive testing of Credit System implementation. All backend APIs (auth, wallet, credits) pass 100%. Frontend flows (registration, login, navbar auth state, buy credits page) verified working. Fixed bug in /api/credits/checkout endpoint (duplicate Request parameter). Stripe checkout integration working.
